s: subarctic wilderness famous for a rare clear-sky "blue hole" over the best aurora viewing in Europe
w: Birch forest, the Torneträsk lake shore and the long Kungsleden trail meet here at one of Europe's most reliable spots for seeing the northern lights -- a local microclimate often keeps a break in the cloud cover (the "blue hole") directly over the valley even when the rest of Lapland is overcast. Deeply quiet, especially outside midsummer, with a scale that makes the far north feel genuinely vast.
_facts: National park in Swedish Lapland, near Abisko village and Kiruna, established 1909
Sits on Lake Torneträsk and the start of the Kungsleden long-distance trail
Known for a local "blue hole" microclimate that frequently keeps skies clear for aurora viewing
One of the most visited sites in Europe for northern lights tourism
